ledger.registrationStatus: Form S-1 registration statement effective September 14, 2026; 4,044,975 VWAP Shares registered for resale under the prospectus.
ledger.terms: Under the June 16, 2026 Common Shares Purchase Agreement, AIxC may issue and sell common shares to the investor through one or more VWAP purchases, with an aggregate commitment of up to $50 million. The 4,044,975 registered shares are limited to shares issuable under the agreement; the excerpt does not establish that all or any shares have been issued or sold.
ledger.eligibilityAssessment: The effective S-1 permits the registered resale of up to 4,044,975 VWAP Shares by the selling stockholder. The agreement's investment period commenced upon effectiveness, but actual company issuances and resale activity are not confirmed by this evidence. [112791, 112793]
